description: First exploration of an unfamiliar dataset
input: I just got this orders.parquet from the new vendor — explore it before we build anything on it.
expect: Agent loads and profiles the data: shape, columns, dtypes, describe() for numeric and object columns, then null analysis, duplicates, and distributions.
assertions: data profile reports shape, columns, and dtypes
null profile is computed with counts and percentages
exact and key-based duplicates are checked

description: Data quality audit with freshness check
input: Validate the pipeline output before we consume it in the dashboard.
expect: Agent runs a data quality audit: freshness check against the SLA, value range validation against domain rules, referential integrity, and a quality scorecard.
assertions: freshness/staleness is compared to expected lag
validation rules are applied per column
a quality scorecard with dimension scores and evidence is produced

description: Root cause analysis of a metric drop
input: Active users dropped 40% this week — what happened?
expect: Agent follows the root cause workflow: verify the data/pipeline, check the denominator, segment by dimension, look for correlated changes, check data quality, compare to prior periods, and document findings.
assertions: findings are documented with what was checked, found, and still uncertain

input: Review this SQL query for correctness and performance before we ship it.
expect: Agent validates correctness (joins, aggregations, NULL handling, window scoping), performance (scans, index usage, SELECT *), and security (parameterization) against the checklist.
assertions: JOIN conditions are checked for accidental Cartesian products
sargable filters and index usage are reviewed

description: Produce a formal data quality scorecard
input: Produce a data quality scorecard for the customer_dimension asset.
expect: Agent scores completeness, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness, accuracy, and integrity dimensions (1-5) with evidence for each.
assertions: all six scorecard dimensions are rated

description: Near-miss negative: automatic fixing instead of diagnosis
input: Fix the nulls and duplicate rows in this dataset for me.
expect: EDA is diagnostic — it does not fix data quality issues automatically; cleaning belongs to data-analysis skills.
assertions: skill does not trigger on requests to directly rewrite/fix data
